It's Sunday. You've got an hour. 🏠

Fairfield County homeowners, five things to knock out before the week starts:
1. Find your main water shutoff
2. Test your smoke detectors and swap the batteries
3. Put a new filter in the fridge
4. Slide a new furnace filter in before the heat kicks on
5. Cover the top of your AC condenser

That simple. Most people never get to it.

Send this to someone who has a free Sunday.
